name: notifaction de demande la facture CDM

parameters.query:
SELECT
  '{{ $json.WEB_0 }}' as WEB_0,
  '{{ $json.DOCOR_0 }}' as DOCOR_0,
  '{{ $json.ACCDAT_0 }}' as ACCDAT_0,
  '{{ $json.BPCNUM_0 }}' as BPCNUM_0,
  '{{ $json.MNT_0 }}' as MNT_0,
  '{{ $json.code_article }}' as code_article,
  '{{ $json.designation }}' as designation,
  IF(COUNT(*) > 0, 'existe', 'pas_existe') AS status,
  
  MAX(id_df) AS id_df
FROM suivi_df
WHERE docor = '{{ $json.DOCOR_0 }}' and status <>'repondu';

WITH MAP_TIERS (BPCNUM, code_article, designation) AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        ('T6296', 'A15000', 'REDEVANCE LOCATIVE OBJET DU CONTRAT CREDITBAIL 01 MOTEUR ELECTRIQUE EN FONTE ABB'),
        ('T6638', 'A15283', 'REDEVANCE LOCATIVE OBJET DU CONTRAT CREDIT BAIL HYUNDAI H100'),
        ('T6664', 'A15284', 'REDEVANCE LOCATIVE OBJET DU CONTRAT CREDIT BAIL 6 RENAULT CLIO5 '),
        ('T6916', 'A15717', 'REDEVANCE LOCATIVE OBJET DU CONTRAT DE CREDIT BAIL PONT BASCULE ELECTRONIQUE')
    ) AS V(BPCNUM, code_article, designation)
)
SELECT
    ADR.WEB_0,
    RNR.DOCOR_0,
    RNR.ACCDAT_0,
    RNR.BPCNUM_0,
    RNR.MNT_0,
    MAP.code_article,
    MAP.designation
FROM BASE1.XREGNLR RNR
INNER JOIN MAP_TIERS MAP
        ON MAP.BPCNUM = RNR.BPCNUM_0
LEFT JOIN BASE1.BPADDRESS ADR
        ON ADR.BPANUM_0 = RNR.BPCNUM_0
LEFT JOIN BASE1.BPSUPPLIER SUP
        ON SUP.BPSNUM_0 = ADR.BPANUM_0;
